angle: physical print-shop craft - screen-printed plastics, registration marks, halftone dots, foil rims, hot-stamp dies.

families.name: Halftone Screen
families.concept: Duotone halftone wedge: one ink, screened on a rotated grid, ramping from an open tint into solid coverage.

params.seed: picks the screen angle (15/45/75/105 deg), the direction the tint wedge ramps in, the minimum dot size (how open the light end stays) and the phase of the four rim register ticks.
params.base: the plastic - fills the disc under the screen and knocks out the label plate at 220.
params.accent: the single ink - every dot, the rim ring and the register ticks.
params.label: hot-stamped into a knockout plate at the bottom of the face; drawn only at 220, uppercased, clipped to 10 characters.

families.name: Register Mark
families.concept: A press registration target laid over the whole face: crosshair to the rim, four quadrants inked at descending tint steps, crop marks, bullseye at centre.

params.seed: rotates the whole assembly, chooses which quadrant carries solid ink (the other three step down from it), sets the crosshair centre gap and nudges the crop mark inset.
params.base: the plastic; also knocks out the bullseye core and the label plate.
params.accent: the ink - quadrant tints, crosshair, bullseye rings, crop marks.
params.label: knockout plate at the bottom of the face, 220 only, uppercased, clipped to 10 characters.

targets.220: adds finer bullseye ring + label plate

families.name: Hot Foil
families.concept: A hot-stamp foil die: faceted badge, a sheen band raked across the facets, and the knurled tick ring the die leaves in the rim.

params.seed: chooses the die shape (hex or octagon), rotates the die, sets the rake angle of the foil sheen band and the phase of the knurl ring.
params.base: the plastic; also the knockout keyline inside the badge and the label plate.
params.accent: the foil - badge fill, knurl ticks and rim ring.
params.label: knockout plate at the bottom of the face, 220 only, uppercased, clipped to 10 characters.

targets.42: 12 long knurl teeth, solid badge, bevel split + specular band

notes: Every family draws all seeded identity parameters before it branches on target, so 42/96/220 consume identical RNG and only the level of detail changes; stroke widths are floored through _sw() so no line falls under a device pixel at 42. Cards are laid out in fixed natural units per layout (single standard 400x176, single gallery 320x404, battle standard 700x300, battle stacked 420x452) and `width` only scales the viewBox, so a 400px and a 700px render are the same drawing. Disc art is inlined into a <g transform> copy with every id namespaced per participant - not a nested <svg>, because a host stylesheet that sizes `svg` elements (the tournament rasteriser ships one) would otherwise resize the artwork. details=False drops the mold line and the flight cells and widens the battle score slot; a presentationId with no art falls back to a dashed 'NO PLATE' well rather than failing. Card ground is warm press paper with the participant's own colour used as the spot ink.
